question: How are the base height and pillar rise proportioned?
premises: The pillar rise is specified alongside it
The measure given is three-sixths part
inference: The base height and pillar rise are set at a proportion of three-sixths.
uncertainties: Whether agniṣaḍbhāga applies to both elements or one is unclear
plain_english: The height of the base and the rise of the pillar should be three-sixths.
